name: Riley Evans
life: “I still remember working my first shift after the bandages came off.” Thursday often includes a stop at Lighthouse Cove, where Riley takes a few minutes by the low rocks, where conversation sounds different as the tide turns.
voice: I used to hide my fingers after a factory injury. I asked to sit as a separate model on my own terms.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a dark green knitted vest and a tiny red thread tied through the lowest buttonhole. Riley has a wide brow and a narrow jaw, with short black hair swept back. Riley starts to lift a hand, then waits to be invited to speak during a conversation.
personality: Riley listens for the familiar version of a story and then for the one detail that changes it. Friends bring problems here when they want to be heard twice.
agenda: To make a separate portrait on independent terms.
family: Ignacio Schmidt is Riley’s second cousin. Riley brings something that can still be enjoyed tomorrow. Ignacio checks the date twice. Arrangements do change in their family. Taking a delay seriously without treating it as an insult took both of them years. Asked about *The skipper goes ashore*, Ignacio says, “I can face a hard crossing and can't face my crew seeing me wait for the nausea to settle.”
connections: Casey Hunter. The original fishing partner meets a second worker who will model an injury on separate terms.

reactions.response: Riley asks the model whether the original permission covers the scar.

reactions.situation: A colleague says somebody used the wrong name in public
reactions.response: Riley repeats the correct name quietly, making the correction easy to hear without turning it into a performance.
